source.title: Soft Male Vocal, Short Pained/Exhertion Groans - Vocal Efforts
source.author: salemaudio
source.prepare: ffmpeg -i <file> -ac 1 -af "rubberband=pitch=1.1892:formant=shifted:pitchq=quality" -c:a pcm_f32le salem_p3.wav (up 3 semitones, the formants with it, the length kept), then --source salem_p3.wav
source.notes: 44.1 kHz stereo, 15 s, a Neat King Bee into an Audient Evo 4: ten soft grunts and sighs by one man, 75-89 dB over a near-silent background. The first five, low soft 'hup' sounds (140-1600 Hz), are the jump; the later ones rise into pained and knockout sounds and are left out. Raised 3 semitones, pitch and formants together, so the voice reads as neither man nor woman (chosen by ear from 0, +2, +3 and +4); the jump factory varies it 0.9-1.1 as it plays.
